verdict.rationale: Natural language is Copilot's primary interface. The docs show prompt-driven work in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, plain-language queries over connected email, calendar and files, and voice prompts. They also show the agent acting on instructions: Browse with Copilot clicks, types and navigates in Edge, and Cowork handles multi-step tasks. One user independently praises its cross-document retrieval, but another hands-on report says Copilot in Word could only append text and could not create tables, search/replace or keep formatting. That limits how far the Office integrations follow commands without contradicting the core claim. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that Browse/Cowork agentic actions work as described, and reliable natural-language editing inside Office apps (Word table, formatting and search/replace commands reported failing).
